sources.title: Fine-tuning Whisper Tiny for Swahili ASR: Challenges and ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technologies have seen significant advancements, yet many widely spoken languages remain underrepresented. This paper explores the fine-tuning of OpenAI's Whisper Tiny model (39M parameters) for Swahili, a lingua franca for over 100 million people across East Africa.
